Укажите дату выезда полностью: день, месяц и год.

actual_source.causal_attribution: T6 whole prefix на was not recognized by the deterministic date helper. The model detected the correct conflict; generic conflict humanization lost its explanation. New addressed-prefix handling bypasses this specific failing route; it is not a claim to repair all model conflict rendering.

new_contract.scope: Only an exact fresh server-owned checkout target, known December check-in and unset checkout can offer the adjacent January year candidate. Other missing-year dates retain the full-year/no-guess policy.
new_contract.prefix: Whole bounded на + exact supported date token, only fresh owned date question. No dropping text before a first date, arbitrary extraction, new target selection or year inference.
new_contract.invalid_same_month: 27 December in the known check-in year before 28 December is explained with both absolute dates, operations0; never rolled into the next December.
new_contract.confirmation: Candidate has operations0. Exact yes revalidates provenance/baseline/clock, recurses with absolute ISO after removing the local year packet, then runs full domain validation. Existing duration conflict remains a separate question with operations0.
new_contract.negative_answer: No clears the candidate and leaves all dates unchanged; late yes cannot replay it.
new_contract.root_harness_hook: Parent retains only exact year owner/kind/checkout field/target/trip/current strict integer version. Original deferred target-selection cleanup remains unchanged.
new_contract.controls: Pause/cancel/resume and compound edits are not swallowed as year consent.
new_contract.source_or_booking_effects: No provider search, model request, quote or order is created by the pure helper.

tests.ruff: PASS for changed source and two new tests

pg_assertions: Addressed invalid December checkout produces specific date explanation and no revision/model call.
January candidate survives real Store/API serialization with genuine outward target but no trip change.
Yes commits one checkout revision and matching return leg, preserving other facts.
No then late yes never commits checkout.
Unrelated public typed budget revision clears the old candidate; late yes does not replay it.
All these paths have no TOOL_CALL_STARTED and no orders.

limitations: The initial API question/stay is labelled controlled setup; this is not a new complete owner14 actual replay.
